verdict.rationale: Meltano is CLI-first: projects, plugins, config, stream selection and pipeline runs are all driven by documented CLI commands and version-controlled YAML. That gives an automation-friendly user near-complete programmatic control of the self-hosted product. However, no HTTP or REST API is evidenced (the OpenAPI probes all 404), and nothing shows parity between the hosted offering's interface and any API. Missing for 10: a documented HTTP/REST API with an OpenAPI spec, evidence of UI-to-API parity for the managed/hosted offering, and independent corroboration.
